title: Athlete, Soldier, Farmer (Paul)
summary: Consider focused service, disciplined effort, and patient labour through three illustrations.

title: City on a Hill
summary: Explore the image of a visible city within Jesus’ teaching about light.

title: Cloth and Wineskins
summary: Consider Jesus’ paired illustrations of a new patch and new wine.

title: Jesus Heals a Centurion's Servant
summary: Reflect on a centurion’s humble trust in the authority of Jesus’ word.

title: Jesus Heals a Lame Man at the Pool of Bethesda
summary: Read how Jesus noticed a man who had been ill for thirty-eight years at Bethesda.

title: Jesus Heals a Man Born Blind
summary: Explore the healing, testimony, and growing recognition of Jesus in the account of a man born blind.

title: Jesus Heals a Man with Dropsy
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ compassion and his question about healing on the Sabbath.

title: Jesus Heals a Man with Leprosy
summary: Discover Jesus’ compassionate response to a man who asked to be made clean.

title: Jesus Heals a Man’s Withered Hand
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ teaching about doing good on the Sabbath as he restores a man’s hand.

title: Jesus Heals a Mute Demon-Possessed Man
summary: Explore the healing of a man unable to speak and the contrasting responses to Jesus’ work.

title: Jesus Heals a Nobleman’s Son
summary: Explore the royal official’s trust in Jesus’ word before he learned his son had recovered.

title: Jesus Heals a Paralytic
summary: Read how Jesus forgave and healed a paralysed man brought to him by others.

title: Jesus Heals a Woman Crippled for Eighteen Years
summary: Consider Jesus’ care for a woman bent over for eighteen years and his defence of her freedom on the Sabbath.

title: Jesus Heals a Woman with an Issue of Blood
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ compassionate response to a woman who had suffered bleeding for twelve years.

title: Jesus Heals Bartimaeus, a Blind Beggar
summary: Read how Bartimaeus called for mercy and followed Jesus after receiving his sight.

title: Jesus Heals Many at the Sea of Galilee
summary: Read about the crowds who gathered by the sea as Jesus healed many people.

title: Jesus Heals Many Sick at Evening
summary: Explore the Gospel accounts of people bringing those who were suffering to Jesus at evening.

title: Jesus Heals Peter’s Mother-in-Law
summary: Consider Jesus’ care for Peter’s mother-in-law and her response after the fever left her.

title: Jesus Heals Ten Lepers
summary: Discover the gratitude of the one man who returned to thank Jesus after ten were cleansed.

title: Jesus Heals the Ear of Malchus
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ healing response during the violence surrounding his arrest.

title: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
summary: Read how two blind men called to Jesus for mercy and received their sight.

title: Lamp on a Stand
summary: Reflect on a lamp placed where its light can be useful and on listening carefully to Jesus.

title: Light of the World
summary: Consider how visible good works can direct praise to the Father.

title: Living Stones (Peter)
summary: Explore the image of believers being built together into a spiritual house.

title: Living Water
summary: Explore Jesus’ promise of living water and John’s explanation of the Spirit.

title: Milk and Solid Food (Paul)
summary: Reflect on spiritual growth through the comparison between milk and solid food.

title: Salt of the Earth
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ image of salt and the distinctive calling of his disciples.

title: The Armor of God (Paul)
summary: Consider the armour imagery of truth, righteousness, faith, salvation, God’s word, and prayer.

title: The Blind Leading the Blind
summary: Consider Jesus’ warning about unreliable guidance and the need for discernment.

title: The Body of Christ (Paul)
summary: Reflect on unity, differing gifts, and mutual care through Paul’s image of one body with many parts.

title: The Bread of Life
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ declaration that he is the bread of life and his invitation to come and believe.

title: The Camel and the Eye of a Needle
summary: Reflect on wealth, dependence on God, and Jesus’ striking picture of a camel and a needle.

title: The Door of the Sheep
summary: Consider Jesus’ image of the door through which the sheep find safety and pasture.

title: The Good Shepherd
summary: Explore Jesus’ description of the shepherd who knows his sheep and lays down his life for them.

title: The Harvest
summary: Explore harvest imagery in Jesus’ call to prayer and participation in God’s work.

title: The Parable of the Cost of Discipleship
summary: Consider Jesus’ call to count the cost of following him through the illustrations of a builder and a king.

title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
summary: Discover how compassion becomes action through the Samaritan who stopped to care for a wounded stranger.

title: The Parable of the Great Banquet
summary: Reflect on the invitation to a great banquet and the excuses that keep people from responding.

title: The Parable of the Hidden Treasure
summary: Reflect on the joy of discovering God’s kingdom through the treasure hidden in a field.

title: The Parable of the Lost Coin
summary: Reflect on the careful search for a lost coin and the joy when it is found.

title: The Parable of the Lost Sheep
summary: Discover the joy of finding the lost sheep and Jesus’ teaching about care and repentance.

title: The Parable of the Minas
summary: Consider responsibility and accountability through the servants entrusted with their master’s money.

title: The Parable of the Mustard Seed
summary: Discover encouragement in the contrast between a tiny mustard seed and the large plant it becomes.

title: The Parable of the Net
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ illustration of a fishing net and his teaching about judgment at the end of the age.

title: The Parable of the Pearl of Great Value
summary: Consider the surpassing value of God’s kingdom through a merchant’s discovery of a precious pearl.

title: The Parable of the Persistent Widow
summary: Find encouragement to pray without losing heart through the widow who persisted in seeking justice.

title: The Parable of the Pharisee and the Tax Collector
summary: Reflect on humility and mercy through two contrasting prayers in the temple.

title: The Parable of the Prodigal Son
summary: Explore a father’s welcome, a younger son’s return, and an older brother’s struggle to share the joy.

title: The Parable of the Rich Man and Lazarus
summary: Reflect on neglected suffering, a reversal after death, and the call to listen to Scripture.

title: The Parable of the Sower
summary: Reflect on the four kinds of soil and how we receive God’s Word.

title: The Parable of the Two Sons
summary: Discover why a changed response and obedient action matter more than an unfulfilled promise.

title: The Parable of the Unforgiving Servant
summary: Explore the contrast between receiving great mercy and refusing to show mercy to someone else.

title: The Parable of the Unjust Steward
summary: Consider the dishonest manager’s urgent planning and Jesus’ teaching about faithful stewardship.

title: The Parable of the Workers in the Vineyard
summary: Consider generosity, grace, and contentment through the vineyard owner who paid workers hired at different hours.

title: The Parable of the Yeast
summary: Explore Jesus’ illustration of yeast working through dough and reflect on the transforming influence of God’s kingdom.

title: The Strong Man
summary: Explore the strong-man illustration in Jesus’ response to accusations about his authority.

title: The Vine and the Branches
summary: Reflect on remaining in Christ and bearing fruit through the image of a vine and its branches.

title: The Way, the Truth, and the Life
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ answer to Thomas and his teaching about coming to the Father.
